# Mosaic

> Mosaic is a content-driven framework for documentation sites: it pulls docs from many sources and renders them with Next.js.

## [Mosaic](https://mosaic-mosaic-dev-team.vercel.app/mosaic/index.md)

- [Sitemap](https://mosaic-mosaic-dev-team.vercel.app/mosaic/sitemap.md): Mosaic namespaces sitemap
